mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening economy, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances following a 3-month GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances following a 1% MoM drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 5% MoM & RSAFS > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a month signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE drops > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, it signals a monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% & CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances following a 3-month RSAFS increase.
